people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Vashti
people.line: Queen of Persia, deposed by King Ahasuerus (Xerxes)

translations.web: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
translations.bsb: And the king loved Esther more than all the other women, and she found grace and favor in his sight more than all of the other virgins. So he placed the royal crown upon her head and made her queen in place of Vashti.
